mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) total FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT rh.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_ID, h.REQ_HEAD_ID, h.REQ_HEAD_NO, h.PROJECT_NAME, rh.apply_by_nickname, rh.APPLY_DATE, g.USER_ID, p.SOU_NO FROM meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_req_head h JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_supplier_cooperate.scc_pr_requirement_head rh ON rh.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_ID = h.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_ID JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_supplier_cooperate.scc_npm_pr_require_head nph ON nph.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_ID = rh.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_ID AND nph.HAS_CREATE_VENDOR_RECOMMEND = 'N' AND nph.NEED_PUBLIC = 'Y' JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_supplier_cooperate.scc_npm_pr_require_group g ON g.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_ID = rh.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_ID AND g.GROUP_TYPE = 'VENDOR' and g.USER_ID = #{userId} LEFT JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_demand d ON d.APPLICANT_NO = rh.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_NUM LEFT JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_sou_project p ON p.PROJECT_ID = d.PROJECT_ID AND p.SOU_TYPE = 'bid' WHERE h.IS_PUBLIC = 'Y' AND h.PUBLIC_END_TIME < NOW() and h.`STATUS` IN ('SIGNUP_DONE') ) t WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY t.REQ_HEAD_ID ORDER BY t.SOU_NO DESC, t.REQ_HEAD_ID DESC ) a

SELECT COUNT(1) total FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT rh.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_ID, rh.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_NUM, nph.PROJECT_NAME, rh.apply_by_nickname, rh.APPLY_DATE, g.USER_ID, p.SOU_NO FROM meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_supplier_cooperate.scc_pr_requirement_head rh JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_supplier_cooperate.scc_npm_pr_require_head nph ON nph.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_ID = rh.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_ID AND nph.NEED_PUBLIC = 'N' AND nph.HAS_CREATE_VENDOR_RECOMMEND = 'N' JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_supplier_cooperate.scc_npm_pr_require_group g ON g.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_ID = rh.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_ID AND g.GROUP_TYPE = 'VENDOR' AND g.USER_ID = #{userId} LEFT JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_demand d ON d.APPLICANT_NO = rh.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_NUM LEFT JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_sou_project p ON p.PROJECT_ID = d.PROJECT_ID AND p.SOU_TYPE = 'bid' WHERE rh.AUDIT_STATUS='APPROVED' AND nph.SOU_REQ_STATUS IN ('EXECUTING', 'PROJECT') ) t WHERE 1 = 1 ORDER BY t.SOU_NO DESC, t.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_ID DESC ) a
